q: Basic chemistry is the branch of science that studies the preparation, properties, structures and reactions of material substances.
e: True. Basic chemistry is the branch of science that studies the preparation, properties, structures and reactions of material substances. A property is physical if measuring it leaves the substance itself unchanged, and chemical if composition changes.
